summary.text: Trojan whom peerless Teucer brought down with his mighty bow when Ajax covered him with his shining shield — a namesake of Ophelestes the Paeonian whom Achilles slew beside Scamander.

story.text: Whom first of the Trojans did peerless Teucer slay? After Orsilochus and Ormenus he laid Ophelestes on the bounteous earth, one after another with Daetor, Chromius, godlike Lycophontes, Amopaon, and Melanippus, while Agamemnon waxed glad at the havoc in the Trojan battalions.
